title: What's New in Shopify Connector: Metafields (2025 release wave 1)

features.name: Metafields synchronization from Shopify
features.description: Flexible way to add and store additional information about Shopify resources such as customers or companies. Users can synchronize and manage metafields in Business Central via UI or extensibility model.
caveats: Metafields are non-editable because synchronization is from Shopify
For B2B companies, synchronization is not for all companies and requires the can update Shopify companies toggle to be on

features.name: Metafield mapping via extensibility model
features.description: Developers can map standard or custom fields and related entries in Business Central to Shopify metafields using an extensibility model, with code samples available in documentation.
caveats: Code samples are available in the documentation

features.name: Metafield definitions display in Shopify company card
features.description: Metafield definitions created by administrators in Shopify are shown in the Shopify company card for easy data entry, with administrators able to import meta field definitions.

quotes.text: Meta fields are a flexible way to add and store additional information about Shopify resources such as a customer or company.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core purpose of metafields as a mechanism for extending Shopify data in Business Central.

quotes.text: Developers can map standard or custom fields and related entries in Business Central to Shopify meta fields using an extensibility model.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the developer extensibility approach for metafield integration, enabling custom mapping scenarios.

quotes.text: These fields are non-editable because synchronization is from Shopify.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important caveat establishing read-only nature and directional synchronization from Shopify as the source.

quotes.text: For B2B companies, synchronization is not for all companies and the can update Shopify companies toggle is on.
quotes.why_it_matters: Key limitation for B2B scenarios establishing conditional synchronization behavior.

quotes.text: In this release, we can import meta field definitions requiring only the input of necessary data.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that metafield import capability is available in this release with simplified data entry requirements.
